title: Filtered-side node address check attestation
description: Version 1 contract for one signed reachability check of a new node address from one filtered-side vantage. An operator-run producer (the RIPDPI diagnostics address check) connects to the node listener over TCP, completes a TLS handshake, and signs the result. The deployer admits the address into a client bundle only with a fresh passing attestation from a trusted vantage key (scripts/address_admission.py). The signature is Ed25519 over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the document without the signature member: keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8. All strings are ASCII and all numbers are integers, so Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) produces the same bytes. icmp is a hint only and is never admission evidence. contract/node-address-check.golden.json is signed with the test-only Ed25519 seed of 32 bytes of 0x01.
$comment: Canonical source: ripdpi-vpn-deploy/contract/node-address-check.schema.json. Keep the client vendored copy byte-identical. x-contract-version is the cross-repo drift pin.

address.description: Node address as an IPv4 dotted quad or a compressed IPv6 literal, as the bundle publishes it.

port.description: Listener port that the TCP and TLS probes used.

checked_at.description: Probe completion time in UTC with second precision.

vantage.description: Where the check ran. side is always filtered; an unfiltered vantage cannot produce this attestation. The vantage identity is the signing key; the document carries no device, subscriber or network operator identifier.

probes.description: tcp is a connect to address:port. tls is a complete TLS handshake on that connection; it is not_run when tcp did not pass. icmp is an echo hint that the deployer ignores.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, standard base64.
